identityTradability.exchangeName: Meta Platforms, Inc. - Class A Common Stock

structural-causal.name: AI infrastructure causal conversion
structural-causal.basis: Revenue, ad impressions and ad pricing grew strongly while capex accelerated sharply; the bridge from infrastructure spend to durable incremental monetization remains the key falsifiable link.

structural-causal.name: scenario robustness
structural-causal.basis: Large cash generation and scaled ad demand support resilience, while unusually high infrastructure intensity creates a successor bottleneck in power, compute deployment and return-on-capital conversion.

discovery-weak-signals.name: core monetization scale
discovery-weak-signals.basis: Both ad volume and pricing grew double digits while revenue rose 28%.

adversarial-red-team.name: capital intensity and conversion risk
adversarial-red-team.basis: Rapid infrastructure spending materially compresses near-term free-cash conversion even as core advertising execution remains strong.

expectations-execution.name: AI investment conversion
expectations-execution.basis: Strong revenue/advertising execution is paired with unusually high capital intensity, so future returns on infrastructure are a key expectation test.

items.risk: Q2 costs and expenses rose 55% year over year and capex was $31.08B, making AI infrastructure intensity a material execution burden.
Legal charges, severance and rapid infrastructure spending can obscure normalized cost conversion and raise disappointment risk if AI monetization lags.
If incremental AI infrastructure fails to sustain engagement, ad efficiency or new monetization at adequate returns, the current positive causal chain weakens despite strong top-line growth.
High fixed infrastructure commitments raise downside sensitivity if AI monetization or engagement benefits arrive slower than spending growth.
Legal charges and severance can obscure normalized cost trends, increasing interpretation uncertainty.

contradictions.claimA: Core advertising demand and pricing are strong.

contradictions.resolution: These are simultaneous operating facts rather than mutually exclusive claims; the unresolved economic question is future return on the investment, treated as a non-gating unknown rather than a fabricated contradiction.
